critique: The delivered field-level contribution is the exact finite-dimensional canonical-gradient characterization, backed by a tangent-completeness theorem, a strict-gain criterion, and a nonbinary continuous witness. Canonicality is proved only at the specially defined two-sided pathwise-interior laws satisfying quantitative feature, posterior-Gram, and projection-Gram separation, whereas the TL;DR states the result for fixed K without that material qualifier. The cross-fitted limit theorem is conditional on aggregate nuisance and derived-operator rates, and the proposed spline product-likelihood estimator is not proved to satisfy them, so the note does not deliver an end-to-end feasible efficiency guarantee. The maternal-smoking use case remains prospective and supplies neither verification of the identifying assumptions nor an empirical demonstration, limiting the significance and reproducible applied evidence expected at a leading econometrics journal. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
